title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Advance Sales Pass Nayanthara's Previous Opener
excerpt: The Tamil fantasy sequel, releasing November 6 for Diwali, has Rs 1.26 crore in India advance sales, according to Koimoi — already above Hi's Rs 1.25 crore opening day, with a day of pre-sales left.
body:
• Mookuthi Amman 2, a Tamil-language fantasy comedy starring Nayanthara and directed by Sundar C, releases worldwide in theatres on November 6, 2026, for Diwali.
  • Koimoi reported advance sales of Rs 1.26 crore for opening day in India — 82,925 tickets across 1,869 shows in 664 theatres — already above the Rs 1.25 crore opening-day total of Nayanthara's previous release, Hi. These are advance estimates, not box-office results.
  • Separately, Filmibeat reported Tamil Nadu day-one pre-sales crossing Rs 90 lakh and weekend pre-sales past Rs 2 crore, citing box-office tracker Jerin Georgekutty — a different, state-level count from Koimoi's India figure.
  • The film faces a crowded Diwali frame against Suriya's Scene and Ramayana: Part 1, according to Koimoi; actual collections will only be known after release.

What the film is

Mookuthi Amman 2 is a Tamil-language fantasy comedy and the sequel to Mookuthi Amman, which was released on JioHotstar in 2020 and directed by RJ Balaji. The sequel — also titled Mookuthi Amman 2: Rise of Mahashakthi / Mahasakthi in some coverage — is directed by Sundar C, who co-wrote it with Venkat Raghavan, according to Koimoi and Filmibeat.

https://x.com/sudhirsrinivasn/status/2118225641871163735

"Hi, a romantic drama, earned Rs 1.25 crore on its opening day in India, Koimoi reported."

Nayanthara plays the lead, alongside Regina Cassandra, Urvashi and Yogi Babu. The film is produced by Dr. Ishari K. Ganesh under Vels Film International, with music by Hiphop Tamizha, according to Filmibeat. Its story, as summarised by both outlets, follows a queen who sacrifices herself to save her son, the prince, from invading enemies; Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who represents a new evil power.

The advance numbers — and what they are not

With one day remaining before release, the film had collected over Rs 1 crore in opening-day advance sales, Koimoi reported, putting the India figure at Rs 1.26 crore from 82,925 tickets booked across 1,869 shows in 664 theatres. Koimoi noted the film is seeing slower advance sales than Scene, and that it will need positive word of mouth to perform well.

https://www.instagram.com/p/DfRlZ_tD5Pc/

The comparison Koimoi led with is to Nayanthara's own previous release. Hi, a romantic drama, earned Rs 1.25 crore on its opening day in India, Koimoi reported. Mookuthi Amman 2 has surpassed that figure with advance collections alone, with a day of pre-sales still left — an advance estimate beating a completed opening-day result, which is why the distinction matters: advance sales are tickets sold before release, not a final collection.

Filmibeat's Tamil Nadu count tells the same story at state level, from a different source. Citing box-office tracker Jerin Georgekutty's update on X on Thursday morning, November 5, Filmibeat reported the film had crossed Rs 90 lakh in Tamil Nadu opening-day advance bookings, with cumulative weekend pre-sales past Rs 2 crore. Filmibeat explicitly noted these figures are advance ticket sales and should not be confused with actual box-office collections.

The Diwali clash

The film arrives in a crowded Diwali weekend. Koimoi reported it faces competition from Suriya's Scene, starring Suriya with Nazriya Nazim and Naslen, and from Ramayana: Part 1. That clash is the risk in the advance story: a sequel that has already beaten its star's previous opener in pre-sales still has to convert word of mouth against two larger rivals once reviews and audience turnout arrive.

How and when to watch

Mookuthi Amman 2 releases worldwide in theatres on Friday, November 6, 2026. The sources reviewed for this article did not list specific US showtimes or a streaming date, so diaspora readers should check local theatre listings for November 6 showtimes in their city rather than rely on a date this article cannot verify. No streaming release has been announced in the sources read.

What happens next is straightforward: final advance totals on release morning, then the first reported opening-day collections — actual results, replacing the estimates above — will show whether the pre-sale lead over Hi turned into a stronger opening.
